> Dual-agent review by **Claude** and **Codex**.
> Requested by @lolipopshock.

## Summary of PR/Issue
PR #278 closes #270 by normalizing weak mention `author_association` values before route authorization. It preserves the existing issue-body live refresh, then adds a shared collaborator fallback for supported mention surfaces. The goal is to avoid rejecting real collaborators on comments, discussions, and PR reviews when GitHub reports weak values like `NONE` or `CONTRIBUTOR`. The PR also updates access-policy docs and adds positive-path regression tests.

## Review
The implementation is in the right layer and keeps the authorization trust boundary conservative. The remaining concern is test coverage: the new behavior lacks direct negative-path coverage and one documented surface is not tested.

| Issue | Severity | Description |
| -- | -- | -- |
| Missing edge-case tests for weak association normalization | WARNING | The new matrix verifies collaborator promotion, but not that non-collaborators remain weak when `GITHUB_REPOSITORY` is set. It also omits top-level `discussion` coverage even though the docs now list discussion bodies. |

## Progress
- The PR already implements shared weak-association normalization, preserves issue-body refresh, and updates `.agent/docs/access-policy.md`.
- Codex review reported `npm --prefix .agent ci`, build, and focused extract-context tests passed on head `1b56a010e35e477a748dae0547cf0070d4d30c45`.
- Rubrics review passed and found the change surgical and aligned with the authorization goal.
- No existing inline comments or review threads were present before synthesis.
- Posted one inline comment on `.agent/src/__tests__/extract-context-cli.test.ts` line 411 covering the missing test cases.

## Issue Details

<details>
<summary>Missing edge-case tests for weak association normalization</summary>

**Cause:** The added `weakMentionCollaboratorCases` all use a collaborator stub that confirms `alice`, so they only prove weak values promote to `COLLABORATOR`. The docs now say normalization applies to discussion bodies, but the matrix covers `discussion_comment`, not the top-level `discussion` event.

**Candidate solutions:** Add a non-issue mention test with `GITHUB_REPOSITORY` set where the collaborator check returns non-204 and the original weak association is preserved. Add a top-level `discussion` event test proving a weak `discussion.authorAssociation` can promote when the collaborator lookup succeeds.

**Comments:** Claude raised these as warnings; Codex and rubrics reviews otherwise considered the implementation sound. The current diff supports treating this as a focused test-only follow-up.

</details>

## Recommended Next Step
FIX_PR: Add the missing regression coverage in `.agent/src/__tests__/extract-context-cli.test.ts`; the work is concrete and safe for an automated fix-pr pass.

## Final Verdict
MINOR_ISSUES

## Action Items
- [ ] Add a non-issue mention negative-path test where `GITHUB_REPOSITORY` is set, collaborator lookup fails, and the weak association is preserved.
- [ ] Add top-level `discussion` event coverage for weak-association normalization.
